title: Druze power struggle (1658–1667)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Druze power struggle (1658–1667)", at revision 1370615878, opens: "The Druze power struggle of 1658–1667 was a violent tribal dispute during Ottoman rule in the Levant. The conflict erupted between rebel and pro-Ottoman Druze factions over succession of the Maani rule." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5309423, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "tribal disputes during Ottoman rule in the Levant". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
